ingredients.raw: 4 cups cooked and chilled rice (short-grain white rice preferred)
ingredients.name: cooked rice

ingredients.raw: 3-4 tablespoons soy sauce, or more to taste
ingredients.name: soy sauce

instructions.text: Heat 1/2 tablespoon butter in a large sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add whisked egg and cook until scrambled, stirring occasionally. Transfer to a separate plate.
Add 1 tablespoon butter to the pan and heat until melted. Add carrots, onion, peas, and garlic; season with salt and pepper. Sauté for 5 minutes until softened.
Increase heat to high, add remaining 1½ tablespoons butter and stir until melted. Immediately add chilled rice, green onions, soy sauce, and oyster sauce; stir to combine.
Continue sautéing for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally to fry the rice and develop crispy edges.
Remove from heat and stir in scrambled eggs and sesame oil. Taste and adjust seasonings with additional soy sauce if needed.
Serve immediately or refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 3 days.
